test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If the volume of a right circular cone of height 30 cm is 160π cm³, find the diameter of its base.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of **Cone** = (1/3) × π × r² × h

160π = (1/3) × π × r² × 30

160 = 10 × r² ⇒ r² = 16 ⇒ r = 4 cm

**Diameter** = 2 × r = 2 × 4 = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Height** (h) of the cone = 30 cm

**Volume** (V) of the cone = 160π cm³

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a **right circular cone** = (1/3)πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc937b9ab25f2b6fc63aafbd44053376afd427f55e12625574430e1c081dd06b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 160π = (1/3) × π × r² × 30

⇒ 160 = 10 × r²

⇒ r² = 160 / 10

⇒ r² = 16

⇒ r = √16 = 4 cm

⇒ **Diameter** (d) = 2 × radius (r)

⇒ d = 2 × 4 = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slant Height of Cone

The slant height (l) is given by the relation l = √(r² + h²).

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The CSA of a right circular cone is given by the formula π × r × l.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The TSA of a cone includes the base area: TSA = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r).</p
